scope: Full IDEA algorithm article only; no completion claim for PES, DES, AES, CMS/S/MIME, modes of operation or the whole library.

coverageRationale.zh: 专门解释 IDEA 这一种 64 位分组密码：8 轮加输出变换、52 个 16 位子密钥、异或/模 2^16 加法/模 2^16+1 乘法、25 位循环移位的密钥扩展、逆子密钥解密、HAC 与 GnuPG 向量，以及 64 位块和弱密钥边界；不把 PES、DES、AES、CMS/S/MIME 工作模式或整个 IDEA 家族并入本实体。
coverageRationale.en: Covers the IDEA 64-bit block cipher: eight rounds plus output transformation, 52 16-bit subkeys, XOR/addition modulo 2^16/multiplication modulo 2^16+1, the 25-bit rotation key schedule, inverse-subkey decryption, HAC and GnuPG vectors, and the 64-bit block and weak-key bounds. It does not absorb PES, DES, AES, CMS/S/MIME modes or the whole IDEA family.
